session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Expanding Triangle, Bull Breakout, Then TR'. After an early LH DT and wedge lows around 4158, a minor reversal off 6 bull bars becomes a bull breakout to the MM target at 4280; the breakout above the micro wedge fails, a tight bear channel fails below its micro wedge, and the day degrades into a trading range with a 12:15 wedge double top selling the close to 4160.
